# Helpdesk & Ticketing

A lightweight support operations platform that centralizes email and chat requests into one unified ticket queue so teams can prioritize, collaborate, and resolve issues without letting anything fall through the cracks.

## Features

- Unified ticket inbox for email and chat requests
- Real-time SLA countdown badges to surface urgent work
- Ticket assignment, internal notes, and agent collaboration
- Canned reply snippets for fast, consistent responses
- Customer portal for thread visibility, resolution status, and satisfaction rating

## Demo login

Use these hardcoded demo credentials to access the preview:

- Email: `demo@example.com`
- Password: `demo`

The preview runs on an in-browser fake backend powered by `localStorage`, so data persists only in your browser during the demo.

When deploying the real application, the frontend is wired to the FastAPI backend in `backend/server.py`, which replaces the fake backend behavior with persistent server-side APIs.

## Tech stack

- Vanilla HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- FastAPI
- SQLite

## Quick start

1. Open the project in a browser by loading `index.html` directly, or serve the folder with any static file server.
2. Try the demo login credentials above.
3. To exercise the API locally, start the FastAPI app and use `curl` against its endpoints.

Example:

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/
```

Then open `index.html` in your browser to use the UI.

## Architecture overview

The project is split into a simple frontend and a backend API:

- The frontend is a single-page experience built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
- During preview mode, it uses an in-browser fake backend backed by `localStorage` to simulate authentication, ticket storage, notes, and replies.
- In production, the frontend switches to the FastAPI server in `backend/server.py`.
- FastAPI provides the real application API and persists data in SQLite.
- This separation keeps the demo frictionless while allowing a straightforward path to a durable backend for deployment.

# Inventory & Orders Tracker

A lightweight inventory and purchase-order tracker that replaces spreadsheet chaos with a real-time, auditable view of stock levels, low-stock alerts, and inbound shipments for small teams.

## Features

- Real-time SKU inventory tracking with current quantity, thresholds, and stock valuation
- Low-stock alert badges when items dip below configurable per-SKU thresholds
- Complete purchase order workflow for creating, receiving, and reconciling POs
- Full audit log of stock adjustments for traceability and accountability
- Clean dashboard with total stock value, SKUs below threshold, and pending PO counts

## Tech stack

- Frontend: vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Backend: FastAPI
- Database: SQLite

## Demo login

Use the hardcoded demo credentials:

- Email: demo@example.com
- Password: demo

The preview environment uses an in-browser fake backend backed by localStorage so you can explore the app instantly without running the server. When deploying, this preview layer is swapped out for the real FastAPI backend in backend/server.py.

curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"demo@example.com","password":"demo"}'

- The browser UI is built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- In preview mode, the frontend talks to a fake backend implemented in-browser using localStorage.
- The fake backend mirrors the same data flow expected from the real API so the UI works without setup.
- In production, backend/server.py provides the FastAPI application and persists data in SQLite.
- Inventory updates, purchase order receipts, and audit log entries are managed server-side so stock changes remain consistent and traceable.

A subscription-based HR onboarding portal that centralizes checklists, documents, and org context so HR teams and new hires can track every onboarding step in one place.

# Invoice & Quote Generator

A subscription-ready invoice and quote SaaS that helps small businesses and freelancers create polished documents, track payment status, and manage quote-to-cash workflows without spreadsheets.

## Features

- Build quotes and invoices from structured line items with quantities, unit prices, and tax calculations.
- Instantly compute subtotals, taxes, and grand totals in real time as you edit.
- Promote approved quotes into invoices with one click while preserving all line item data.
- Track invoice status through Draft, Sent, Paid, and Overdue for clear receivables visibility.
- View monthly revenue summaries for paid, outstanding, and overdue balances.
- Print-optimized invoice layouts designed to look professional when saved as PDF or printed.

## Tech stack

- Vanilla HTML
- Vanilla CSS
- Vanilla JavaScript
- FastAPI
- SQLite

## Quick start

1. Open the project in your browser by loading `index.html` directly, or serve it from any static file server.
2. If you want to exercise the API, start the backend and send requests with `curl` against the FastAPI server.
3. Example:
   - `curl http://localhost:8000/health`
   - `curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"demo@example.com","password":"demo"}'`
4. Open `index.html` in your browser and sign in with the demo account.

The preview includes hardcoded demo credentials:

- Email: `demo@example.com`
- Password: `demo`

The browser preview uses an in-browser fake backend backed by `localStorage` so you can explore the product without a running server. When deploying, that preview layer is swapped for the real FastAPI backend in `backend/server.py`, which persists data in SQLite.

## Architecture overview

The application is split into two layers:

### Frontend

The frontend is a single-page experience built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It handles:

- Authentication UI
- Client management
- Quote and invoice creation
- Real-time totals and tax calculations
- Status transitions for invoices
- Monthly revenue summary views
- Print-friendly rendering

For the demo preview, frontend data access is routed to a lightweight fake backend implemented in the browser with `localStorage`.

### Backend

- Authentication
- CRUD operations for clients, quotes, and invoices
- Quote-to-invoice conversion
- Summary/reporting endpoints
- Persistence via SQLite

### Data flow

- In preview mode, the UI reads and writes from browser storage through the fake backend.
- In deployed mode, the same UI calls the FastAPI API.
- The FastAPI backend stores application data in SQLite and serves as the system of record.

### Deployment model

- `index.html` can be opened directly for a no-install demo experience.
- The backend can be started separately for real persistence and API usage.
- The same frontend can work against either the in-browser mock or the FastAPI server depending on environment configuration.
